hero.title: COIREA Raíces Latinas
hero.subtitle: Bridging Global Resources with Grassroots Impact
hero.description: Empowering purpose-driven organizations across Latin America to scale with clarity, structure, and integrity.

intro.text1: Latin America holds profound intelligence, creativity, and regenerative potential — yet many community-led initiatives and NGOs struggle to scale their impact sustainably.
intro.text2: Not because of lack of purpose, but because of lack of structure that sustains purpose.
intro.bridge: COIREA Raíces Latinas acts as a bridge between global resources and local initiatives.
intro.description: We combine the structured systems thinking of the Global North with the regenerative wisdom of Latin America — helping visionary organizations secure funding, streamline operations, and build capacity for lasting social transformation.

whyCoirea.title: Why COIREA Raíces Latinas?
whyCoirea.subtitle: The COIREA OS adapted for Latin American social impact

gap.title: The Gap We Bridge
gap.description: Many Latin American initiatives are rooted in deep cultural wisdom, community care, and regenerative practices. Yet they often face barriers when navigating global systems:

funding.title: Funding & Funder Readiness
funding.description: Accessing grants, social investment, or philanthropy requires specific reporting structures, strategic plans, and operational frameworks that aren't always intuitive to grassroots movements.

operations.title: Operational Capacity
operations.description: Scaling impact requires systems for project management, governance, compliance, and financial sustainability — not just passion and vision.

communication.title: Cross-Cultural Communication
communication.description: Funders and global partners often don't speak the same cultural or operational language as local communities, leading to misalignment and missed opportunities.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.description: We meet organizations where they are — honoring their cultural context and regenerative values — and equip them with the clarity, systems, and frameworks they need to thrive in both local and global ecosystems.

ngos.title: NGOs & Social Enterprises
ngos.description: Building governance, strategic frameworks, and funding-ready operations for nonprofits driving social change.

cooperatives.title: Indigenous & Rural Cooperatives
cooperatives.description: Supporting community-owned initiatives with structure, leadership development, and resource mobilization.

womenLed.title: Women-Led Initiatives
womenLed.description: Empowering female leaders and collectives with tools for financial sustainability and organizational resilience.

regenerative.title: Regenerative Community Projects
regenerative.description: Strengthening ecological and community-centered initiatives through clarity, governance, and impact measurement.

whatWeOffer.title: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.subtitle: Tailored support for your organization's growth

fundingReadiness.title: Funding & Funder Readiness
items: Strategic narrative development for grant applications
Theory of Change & impact measurement frameworks
Funder relationship building and pitch coaching

capacityBuilding.title: Organizational Capacity Building
items: Governance design (board structure, bylaws, decision-making processes)
Operational systems (project management, internal workflows, SOPs)

consciousLeadership.title: Conscious Leadership Development
items: Executive coaching for founders and directors
Conflict resolution and regenerative governance models

coireaOS.title: COIREA OS Implementation
coireaOS.description: A full operating system for organizational clarity and execution — adapted for Latin American contexts.
coireaOS.includes: Strategic planning, OKR frameworks, regenerative rhythms, team alignment rituals, and more.

ourPhilosophy.title: Our Philosophy
ourPhilosophy.subtitle: Rooted in Ayni — the principle of reciprocity

reciprocity.title: Reciprocity Over Extraction
reciprocity.description: We believe in mutual benefit — not just consulting, but co-creating with communities.

integrity.title: Integrity Over Imitation
integrity.description: We don't impose Global North models. We adapt systems to honor local culture, wisdom, and ways of being.

regeneration.title: Regeneration Over Scale at Any Cost
regeneration.description: True impact isn't just about growth — it's about sustainability, wellbeing, and regenerative practices that honor people and planet.

partnership.title: Ready to Bridge Vision with Structure?
partnership.subtitle: Let's build a partnership rooted in reciprocity, clarity, and lasting impact.
